d:
Welcome to the official video for Eric Schenkman's "Hit On Me!" The guitarist, singer, and founding member of New York City’s Spin Doctors shares an upbeat alternative rock and retro R&B-inflected single that transforms heartbreak into possibility. “Hit On Me” is built around infectious grooves, shimmering guitar work, and an unmistakable sense of optimism. It offers a wounded lover a simple invitation: don’t give up on love just yet.
